texts.facts: 2. On going through the same it is seen that, several notices were issued to the petitioner in W.P.(C)No.32224/2024, with regard to the inadequacy in the pollution control measures, particularly in respect of the Effluent Treatment Plant installed by the petitioner. However, despite the passage of several months, effective steps are not seen taken. Even though several proposals were submitted, the Pollution Control Board found that, the said proposals were not sufficient to meet the requirements in the hotel. It is also an undisputed fact that the petitioner could not obtain consent to operate from the Pollution Control Board as well. The application submitted by the petitioner in this regard is already returned to the petitioner by the Pollution Control Board WP(C) No.32372/2024 4/5 Order Date : 28-02-2025 W.P.C Nos.32372 and 32224 of 2024 citing certain defects.
